# Validate tau_filter
    if isinstance(tau_filter, bool):
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must not be a boolean")
    if not np.isfinite(tau_filter) or tau_filter < 0:
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be finite and nonnegative")

    # Validate each input array
    for arr, name in [(logp_with_result, 'logp_with_result'), (logp_call_only, 'logp_call_only'), (logp_no_call, 'logp_no_call')]:
        if not isinstance(arr, np.ndarray):
            raise ValueError(f"{name} must be a numpy ndarray")
        if arr.ndim != 2:
            raise ValueError(f"{name} must be a 2D matrix")
        if arr.size == 0:
            raise ValueError(f"{name} must not be empty")
        if not np.isfinite(arr).all():
            raise ValueError(f"{name} must be finite")
        if (arr > 0).any():
            raise ValueError(f"{name} must be nonpositive")

    # Check shape consistency
    if not (logp_with_result.shape == logp_call_only.shape == logp_no_call.shape):
        raise ValueError("All input matrices must have the same shape")

    # Compute total log probabilities over horizon
    sum_with = logp_with_result.sum(axis=1)
    sum_call_only = logp_call_only.sum(axis=1)
    sum_no_call = logp_no_call.sum(axis=1)

    # Compute improvements and margin (per candidate)
    imp_no_call = sum_with - sum_no_call
    imp_only = sum_with - sum_call_only
    margin = np.minimum(imp_no_call, imp_only)

    # Keep if margin exceeds threshold
    keep = margin > tau_filter

    return keep, margin
